properties.evidence: Both ideas notice the SAME discarded material: what a pre-capture search surfaced, and how relevant each hit was, is read once and thrown away. The 2026-08-10 idea proposed keeping it as a weighted importance signal; this one proposes keeping it as an edge. The earlier one had already seen that the search result carries information worth persisting — it differs on what to do with it, not on the observation. Drawn 2026-08-21.
